unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.3 - THEME 7: LIFE IN NATURE & GLOBAL PROBLEMS

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will design and present a project which focuses on energy consumption. First, they will take photos of their rooms, houses, classrooms, shops or streets, etc. and then decide the problems that cause energy consumption. Then, they will find solutions to these problems and prepare a booklet about it. The booklets might include visuals, graphs, videos, etc. After presenting the booklets of the projects in the classroom, they will share the results with their classmates and prepare a solutions booklet for sustainable energy as a class. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in nature and global problems with its components such as renewable energy in reducing the environmental damage; sustainable agriculture and farming for the future of the world; local knowledge and nature'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school may know what renewable energy in reducing the environmental damage; sustainable agriculture and farming for the future of the world; local knowledge and nature mean in their as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in nature and global problems'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in nature and global problems with its components such as renewable energy in reducing the environmental damage; sustainable agriculture and farming for the future of the world; local knowledge and nature'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about renewable energy in reducing the environmental damage; sustainable agriculture and farming for the future of the world; local knowledge and nature in English by using the target vocabulary. Activity 1: Environmental Statement In this activity, students play different roles such as an environmental expert, government official, renewable energy company representative, local farmer, or corporate industry representative. They respond to a situation where the government wants to use more renewable energy, reduce deforestation, and promote sustainable farming. Each student writes a short statement that supports their role by using target vocabulary and target grammar they have learnt in the theme. For example, the environmental expert might say; renewable energy must have been used earlier. After writing, students share their statements with the class, and everyone discusses the different opinions. This activity helps students practice speaking, writing, and critical thinking. The teacher gives feedback on the use of target vocabulary and target grammar. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about renewable energy and sustainable agriculture and farming for the future of the world in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Energy and Nature In this activity, students work in pairs and use vocabulary cards with the target words such as ''solar energy'', ''soil'', ''biodiversity'', ''sustainable'', ''farming'', and ''energy''. The teacher asks basic questions such as ''Why is solar energy important?'' and ''How can we protect nature when farming?'' Students answer these questions by using short sentences, for example, ''Solar energy protects nature'' or ''We should protect the soil''. The teacher gives feedback by helping students use the correct target vocabulary and grammar. For reinforcement, students may play a vocabulary challenge game at home. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
